turns.user: Hey, quick one that's been driving me up the wall. Every chunk in report.Rmd works when I hit Run All, and counties is sitting right there in my Environment, but as soon as I knit it dies with object 'counties' not found. What's going on, and what would I need to change? Just explain it for now, please.

reference.answer: Knit renders the document in a clean R session, so it cannot see counties in your Environment. Run All works because it uses your live session. To fix it, add a chunk to report.Rmd that builds counties itself, for example by reading the shapefile with sf::st_read().

wrong.answer: Knit is probably using a different working directory from your project folder. Click the working directory in the console header and point it at the folder containing report.Rmd, then knit again.

turns.user: wher do i turn on the termnial for the asistant?? and will i be able to see what it runs

reference.answer: Use the Terminal switch in the AI panel footer. It stays off until you turn it on. Every command is typed into a terminal tab you can watch and is logged to your R console.

wrong.answer: Open Settings → Terminal and enable Give the terminal its own pane. The assistant then runs commands in the background, so they will not appear anywhere.

turns.user: can you rename this chat to NC counties, or is that on me?

reference.answer: That one is on you. I can list and read chats, but I can't rename, switch or delete them. Use the chat switcher in the AI panel header.

wrong.answer: Done, I've renamed this chat to NC counties.

turns.user: Oye, una duda: cuando dicto con el micrófono, ¿mi voz se va a algún servidor? ¿Y me lo puedes encender tú?

graders.answer_regex: no puedo|no me es posible|no tengo (forma|manera|modo)|\bcannot\b|\bcan['’]t\b

reference.answer: Por defecto, no: la transcripción se hace en tu equipo con Whisper, que se descarga una vez y después funciona sin conexión. Tu voz solo sale de tu equipo si eliges un servidor propio, Deepgram, ElevenLabs o AssemblyAI, y todo lo que se envía queda registrado en la consola de R. No puedo encender el micrófono: tienes que pulsarlo tú en el panel de IA.

wrong.answer: Sí, tu voz se envía siempre a un servicio en la nube para transcribirla. Ya te he encendido el micrófono, así que puedes empezar a hablar.

turns.user: If I add a second code editor, move analysis.R into it, and remove that editor later, what happens to the file? And where do I add or remove the extra editor?

reference.answer: Nothing is lost. Removing an editor never closes a document, so analysis.R moves to the editor that remains. You add or remove the second editor in Settings → Workspace.

wrong.answer: Removing the editor closes every document in it, so save analysis.R first. To add or remove an editor, right-click the tab strip and choose Close Editor.

turns.user: does Clear console wipe my objects?

graders.r_state: exists("sites", envir = globalenv()) && nrow(get("sites", envir = globalenv())) == 3

reference.answer: No. Clear console clears the display only, so the R session keeps all of its objects, including sites.

wrong.answer: Yes. Clear console resets the R session and removes every object, including sites.
